diagnosis.title: Navigating your diagnosis
diagnosis.description: Stage-by-stage guidance to understand prostate cancer, weigh treatment choices, and look after day-to-day health.
diagnosis.intro: Start with the stage that matches where you are. Each card opens a focused guide — from first questions after a PSA test through to living well with treatment.

support.title: Supporting a loved one
support.description: Practical and emotional guides for partners, whānau, and friends walking alongside someone with prostate cancer.
support.intro: You are part of this journey, and your own wellbeing matters too. These guides cover the basics of care, how to stay yourself, and where to find real support.

research.title: Clinical data and research
research.description: Structured information for researchers, clinicians, and students — trials, treatment outcomes, and collaboration tools.
research.intro: Explore disease mechanisms, current trials, and New Zealand research pathways. Use these collections as a starting point for deeper reading.
